summary: GSK plc filed a Form 6-K reporting share repurchases under its existing buyback programme. From 24 Feb 2025 to 26 Jun 2026, the Company purchased 123,939,156 ordinary shares for aggregate consideration of just under £2 billion, completing the £2 billion programme announced on 24 Feb 2025. The final week's purchases ranged from 190,887 to 221,637 shares daily at VWAPs of 1,919.89-1,967.46 GBp. Shares are held as treasury; treasury holdings represent 6.70% of voting rights. No board recommendation or advisor named. No premium or regulatory clock; the buyback is a routine capital return executed via a non-discretionary broker agreement. Watch for future buyback authorizations given programme completion, but no risk-arb angle as this is not a tender or going-private transaction.
